description: Radial bars for users by device, with each device name printed at the start of its bar.
overview: A `RadialBarChart` with one bar per record in `chartData`, sweeping from 90 to -200 degrees. Bars are colored through `Cell` and labeled with a `LabelList` that reads names from `chartConfig`. Pressing a bar shows a tooltip.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your records and add a matching entry per item to `chartConfig`, whose colors the `Cell` children read. The component takes no props.
